title: A hypothetical three-VM lab allocation
method: Planning allocation totals 8 GiB for guests on a hypothetical 16 GiB host reserving 8 GiB for host use. Hypervisor overhead and actual resident consumption are not measured.
alt: A hypothetical three-VM lab allocation. Load balancer: 2 GiB; Application one: 3 GiB; Application two: 3 GiB. Illustrative inputs.
